lots.title: Heaven and Earth Begin
poem: Heaven and earth open, a good beginning
The day is right, everything in place
Drawing this is no small thing
Those who walk true are called forward
lots.plain: The verse sees a fresh start with everything already in place, and it favors people who act plainly and honestly. Bring out an idea you have been holding back today and say it straight.
jieqian: The year's time hasn't come yet

lots.title: The Whale Before the Gate
poem: The whale, not yet a dragon, keeps the river
Do not try to rise too high yet
One day its shape will change
And it will leap the Dragon Gate
lots.plain: You are still building strength in familiar waters, and pushing for the leap too early would cost you. Pick one piece of work in front of you today and do it thoroughly, saving your energy for later.

lots.title: Swallow in the Rain
poem: Through wind and rain, heading home
Like a swallow on the wing
Carrying mud to build a nest
The nest falls, and needs mud again
lots.plain: The verse sees hard work that keeps coming undone because it is spread too thin. Choose the one thing that matters most today, make it solid, and let the rest wait.

lots.title: The Old Mirror Made Whole
poem: An ancient mirror, whole once more
What was parted comes back together
The house takes on a new look
Blessings carry on to those who follow
lots.plain: Something that was broken off is ready to reconnect, and old ties may hold new openings. Reach out today to a friend or former coworker you have not talked to in a while.

lots.title: Digging for a Spring
poem: Boring into grassland, searching for a spring
Dig as you might, water won't come
Then, unplanned, a true friend appears
Hand in hand, you climb the sky
lots.plain: Forcing one approach is wearing you out, while help may be waiting somewhere you are not looking. Stop grinding on the same spot today and talk your problem through with someone new.

lots.title: Beneath the Eagle's Cliff
poem: Settling low beneath the cliff
Where the eagle keeps its nest
It takes a steady, sturdy heart
Plan well, and the wide world opens
lots.plain: The verse honors someone willing to start low and carry real weight, planning ahead until there is room to move. Take on a task others are avoiding today and do it carefully.

lots.title: Mud on the Mountain Road
poem: Wandering past barrier after barrier
Wading through mud to cross the mountains
Hoping to find work in distant places
A thousand miles, and still not home
lots.plain: You may feel pulled to keep searching elsewhere, but restless motion is wearing you down right now. Hold off on any sudden change of direction today and steady the work already in your hands.

lots.title: Pines Through Every Season
poem: Pines and cypress thick and thriving
Rain, snow, wind and frost can't harm them
One day, suddenly, they're put to use
Grown into beams that hold a house
lots.plain: Your steady growth through pressure is quietly turning into real strength. Instead of rushing to prove yourself today, spend an hour sharpening a skill you will need later.

lots.title: The Moon at Its Height
poem: Please leave aside the private scheme
Bring this to the fair-minded instead
A clear heart, shining clean
Like the bright moon high at center sky
lots.plain: The verse asks for a clear, open heart, bright and plain as the full moon. If there is a disagreement today, put it openly on the table and speak fairly.
jieqian: In the end, all is clear

lots.title: Holding a Lamp, Seeking Fire
poem: Priceless jade lies hidden in your stone
Yet you go searching distant lands
Like holding a lamp and hunting fire
Better to stop and look close
lots.plain: What you are chasing far away may already be within reach. Take stock today of the skills, tools and people you already have before looking anywhere else.

lots.title: A Guide on the Road
poem: You hope for something rare and fine
But family matters keep you busy
In the end you hit the mark
A guide will lead you to good ground
lots.plain: Small obligations have slowed you down, but someone with experience can help you find the way. When you get stuck today, ask a mentor or senior colleague one clear question.

lots.title: The Turn Is Near
poem: Hard times leave, good times step close
A wise friend comes down the mountain
Word comes with the tiger and hare
Set your mind, and the rush turns calm
lots.plain: The verse sees a turn from hard to easier that is only a step away. If something small goes wrong today, hold off on judging it and try a different angle.

lots.title: The Golden Belt
poem: Raised in a house of plenty
Fine things all around you
Given a purple robe and golden belt
Your name travels across four seas
lots.plain: You have a real foundation to stand on, and the chance to be recognized for it. Show one of your strengths openly today, and pair it with an easy, humble manner.

lots.title: Crane Out of the Cage
poem: Like a crane leaving its cage
Free of the bars, every road opens
North, south, east, west, nothing blocks
You may climb straight to the clouds
lots.plain: Something that has been holding you in is ready to be let go, and the way opens once it is. Drop one old habit or stale task today and use that space for what you actually want to do.

lots.title: Birds Without a Nest
poem: The traveler swallows a bitter day
If trouble flares, don't step close
The nest is broken, the birds unsheltered
Seek the deep woods and settle safe
lots.plain: You may be carrying a grievance that is hard to swallow, and reacting now would only scatter you further. Skip the argument today, find a quiet place to steady yourself, and make your case later.

lots.title: Jade in the Dust
poem: Worried brows begin to ease
Gladness breaks through the clouds
Like jade hidden in the dirt
A skilled hand lifts it into light
lots.plain: Your worries are starting to clear, and good work of yours is waiting to be found. Polish a piece of your work today and show it to someone who knows the field.

lots.title: A Painted Cake
poem: Don't listen to idle gossip
Keep your own quiet practice, morning and night
If wild talk is taken as truth
Can a painted cake ease hunger
lots.plain: Rumors and empty promises are not worth building on. Check any news you hear today before acting on it, and put your effort into what is real.

lots.title: Sun Sets, Moon Rises
poem: The golden sun sinks, the moon climbs east
Day and night turning since ancient times
Seekers of every path do well
Every trade follows its own heart
lots.plain: Like day and night, things are moving in their natural rhythm, and your path fits within it. Work your plan at your own pace today, do your part well, and let the rest unfold.

lots.title: Boat at the Rapids
poem: Launching a boat at the rapids' edge
Why push into wind and waves
If you want a safe, calm crossing
Wait for the water to settle
lots.plain: You are facing fast, unsettled water, and rushing through it now adds risk. If something urgent and tangled lands on you today, pause and gather the facts before you move.

lots.title: Clear Skies After Spring Rain
poem: After long spring rain, the sky clears
Sun and moon grow slowly bright
Old troubles fade, new things take hold
Watch, and leap the Dragon Gate
lots.plain: A long gray stretch is lifting, making room to close the old and open the new. Wrap up one lingering task today, then start the next thing with a free hand.

lots.title: Dragon and Serpent Meet
poem: Yin and yang join as they should
Two families meet in quiet joy
See the dragon and serpent come together
Bears enter dreams, the circle complete
lots.plain: The verse sees two sides fitting well together, each completing the other. It is a good day to talk through a partnership or settle an agreement, and to share a good meal with someone close.

lots.title: Rain on Dry Fields
poem: In drought, the fields lie parched
Then sweet rain falls, soaking through
Flowers, fruit and grass drink deep
Now you know what rain is worth
lots.plain: If you are in a dry stretch, help may arrive in a form you did not expect. Notice who is offering a hand today, and look for one small way to help someone else too.

lots.title: Reaching for the Moon Laurel
poem: Reaching for the laurel on the moon
The sky's gate is not closed to you
Suddenly, good word arrives
Everyone smiles at the flower you wear
lots.plain: The way up is more open than you think, and good word can arrive when you least expect it. Send the application, proposal or invitation you have been holding today.

lots.title: Petals on the Water
poem: No clear reason, no settled home
Drifting like petals on the water
Seeking favor takes hard effort
And still it ends in tangled threads
lots.plain: Things feel muddled and you may be drifting with every current right now. Hold off on big decisions today, stay out of gossip, and sort out your own tasks one at a time.

lots.title: Past the Worry
poem: Past several rounds of worry and danger
From now, you stand on firm ground
An easy heart finds easy plans
Meet someone wise, and do great work
lots.plain: You have come through a stretch of worry and can start building again on steadier footing. Loosen your shoulders today and spend some time talking with someone you trust; a good idea may come from a casual chat.

lots.title: A Letter From Afar
poem: Word drifts down and turns to air
A letter arrives from the sky's edge
It promises the honors you hoped for
Yet in the end, it is empty
lots.plain: Something that sounds wonderful may be thinner than it looks, and your steady ground matters more than a bright promise. Today, before you count on any offer, ask one clear follow-up question and keep tending your own work.

lots.title: Back Against the Mountain
poem: One plan, one use, one written page
You weigh before and after, and hesitate
When the hour comes, help arrives
Like a mountain wall to lean on
lots.plain: You've been thinking hard and holding back, and the verse says support tends to appear when the timing is right. Today, write your plan on one page and ask someone you trust for honest feedback before you choose when to move.

lots.title: Moon Behind Clouds
poem: In the east the moon rises, lovely
In a moment clouds cover its light
It waxes full, and it wanes
Idle talk is only idle talk
lots.plain: Something clear has been briefly clouded over, perhaps by a misunderstanding or loose talk, but the light is still there. Today, resist the urge to explain yourself right away; let things settle and revisit it once the air has cleared.

lots.title: The Sword Leaves Its Sheath
poem: A sword drawn from its case shines
Sheathed, it gathered no dust at all
Now a steady hand brings it out
Its edge and bearing earn respect
lots.plain: Skills you've kept polished out of sight are ready to be seen, especially alongside someone who believes in you. Today, volunteer for one meaningful task and let people watch you do it well.

lots.title: Snake in the Grass
poem: Don't go asking others for favors
A crane flies in; hidden arrows follow
Gather firewood, and a snake waits
Sharp tongues may leave you uneasy
lots.plain: This is a moment to move carefully, since not every helping hand or friendly word is what it seems. Today, handle the important things yourself, ask fewer favors, and keep a little back when you speak.

lots.title: Tea in a Quiet Corner
poem: Sit at ease in a quiet place
Well fed, sip tea, sit or lie down
Set down body and mind, no rush
No blame or trouble comes calling
lots.plain: Nothing here needs to be forced, and calm is your advantage right now. Today, work through your list at an even pace and set aside fifteen minutes for tea and doing nothing.

lots.title: Jade Inside the Stone
poem: The road ahead is distant, yet sure
Who knows there is jade within stone
One day a skilled hand splits it open
And the green jade is finally seen
lots.plain: Your worth may not be visible yet, but it is real and waiting for the right eyes. Today, polish one skill a little further and share your work with someone who truly knows the craft.

lots.title: Treasure Already Within
poem: You carry treasures beyond price
Holding jade, why search outside
Better to wait for a discerning eye
Ease your heart, then ease it more
lots.plain: Much of what you're looking for elsewhere is already in you. Today, skip the comparisons, trust what you've built, and give your full attention to the task in front of you.

lots.title: Red Sun at Noon
poem: Coming and going with grace and respect
Words loyal and kind, promises kept
When the heart is unclear, let it settle
Like the bright red sun at noon
lots.plain: Steady integrity is your strongest footing, and a quiet heart makes the way clear. Today, follow through on one thing you told a friend or teammate you would do.

lots.title: Clearing the Thorns
poem: Straighten your robes, renew the old ways
The path seems endless, yet it pays
Sweep the thorns from the road ahead
Three agree, and walk as one again
lots.plain: This is a time to regroup, reset, and find common purpose with the people around you. Today, sit down with your team to realign on one goal and clear away a small obstacle together.

lots.title: The Monkey Slips Its Chain
poem: Don't fret over the troubles before you
The open ground holds much to gather
Like a monkey slipping its golden chain
Home to its mountain cave, at ease
lots.plain: Something that has been weighing on you is less binding than it feels. Today, deal with one task that's been hanging over you, and notice how much lighter you feel afterward.

lots.title: Candle in the Wind
poem: Waiting for calm and better days
A candle in the wind won't hold
Better to sit in the inner hall
Where a still flame shines unshaken
lots.plain: Pushing hard or standing out right now would only make your light waver. Today, keep a low profile, work quietly at your own rhythm, and skip one unnecessary errand or meeting.

lots.title: Moonlight on a Secret Book
poem: Moonlight on a secret book, so still
Then sudden clouds and mist roll in
Ease your heart until the mist lifts
Then is the time to change course
lots.plain: The way forward is hidden for a while, and that is no reason to worry. Today, hold off on big changes, rest your mind, and make your next move once things look clear again.

lots.title: Polishing Stone Into Mirror
poem: News from far away is hard to read
Don't overthink or force the outcome
Grinding a stone to make a mirror
Only spends your strength in vain
lots.plain: Some results simply aren't yours to reach for right now, and straining after them only wears you down. Today, set aside one thing you can't control and spend your energy on something you can.

lots.title: Sun Sets, Moon Rises
poem: The red sun sinks in the west
The moon rabbit climbs in the east
Yin grows, yang fades, and things flow
A gentle hand now fills the heart
lots.plain: The season around you is shifting, and a softer, more receptive approach suits this turn. Today, adjust one plan to fit the change instead of resisting it, and try a gentler tone in a tricky conversation.

lots.title: Sweetness With a Hook
poem: Remember the good advice you've heard
Don't take a thief in as kin
Don't crave the sweetness of the moment
Think how it may look years ahead
lots.plain: An offer that looks unusually sweet deserves a second look before you commit. Today, when something seems too generous, take time to learn more about who is offering before you say yes.

lots.title: Grace for Every Living Thing
poem: Grace pours down from on high
Ask again; nothing lost, nothing more
All living things share in its blessing
On earth and above, the way opens
lots.plain: You are surrounded by more kindness than you may notice, and it flows outward easily now. Today, pass some of it on: call someone in your family or do a friend a small favor.

lots.title: All Things Complete
poem: Heaven and earth shift, all things whole
Tend yourself, sustain yourself, find peace
The countless forms of life all shine
Each thing as you wish; give thanks
lots.plain: You have what you need to stand on your own and move things forward at your own pace. Today, take one project fully into your own hands, set your own rhythm, and give it your honest best.

lots.title: Black and White Board
poem: Two well-matched players face the board
Black and white, the game undecided
A single move decides it all
Find the move that serves you best
lots.plain: You are evenly matched with a challenge, and one well-considered step will matter more than many hurried ones. Today, before you act on something competitive, pause to find the single key move and make it with care.
jieqian: Is like a game of Go

lots.title: Spring Water When Thirsty
poem: Gentleness has always outlasted force
A house of kindness thrives and flourishes
Whoever draws this lot today
Finds sweet water in their thirst
lots.plain: Softness and goodwill are your real strength now, and they refresh everyone around you. Today, meet a disagreement with patience and one extra measure of understanding.

lots.title: Old Tree Flowers Again
poem: Keep patiently to your old path
Hold your heart steady, think no ill
Wait for someone's gentle push
And the old dry branch will bloom
lots.plain: This isn't the moment to switch directions; steady work in your current lane is quietly building toward something. Today, do your usual work well and keep an eye out for the person whose small help could make the difference.

lots.title: Flowers on Brocade
poem: Flowers on brocade, colors brighter still
Good fortune arrives, joy on both sides
Don't regret that recognition came late
One leap, and the word spreads far
lots.plain: Something you've worked toward for a long time is gaining momentum, and late doesn't mean less. Today, give your long-held goal one more determined push.

lots.title: The Great Bird Takes Wing
poem: In autumn a small bird becomes a roc
Joyful, it loves to soar and climb
Ten thousand miles into the clouds
No other bird can follow it
lots.plain: You are ready for a bigger stretch than you've been allowing yourself. Today, take on one goal slightly beyond your comfort zone and give yourself room to grow into it.
jieqian: A fish becomes a great bird

lots.title: Water Turned to Ice
poem: Sky cold, earth frozen, water ice
Why grasp for honors now
Better to keep to yourself, sit still
When the time turns, all grows clear
lots.plain: Conditions are too cold for forcing hard things forward, and that is a season, not a verdict. Today, prepare quietly for a task you've been pushing, and save the real effort for when things warm up.

lots.title: Sails Full of Wind
poem: Lakes and seas are yours to roam
Raise the sail high and steer freely
When the fair wind comes, it carries you
A boat laden with treasures, layer on layer
lots.plain: Momentum is on your side, and open water invites you to explore. Today, reach out to someone new or visit a place outside your usual circle, and see what the trip brings.

lots.title: A Cool Summer Wind
poem: The longest days of summer burn,
and everyone is worn down by heat.
Yet the world knows how you feel:
a soft breeze comes, and it cools.
lots.plain: You may be running hot and restless, but relief tends to arrive once you stop fighting the heat. When irritation rises today, step away for a few minutes and let yourself cool down before you respond.

lots.title: Reaching for the Moon
poem: You reach to catch the moon in water,
and after all that work, nothing's there.
Let idle talk and gossip pass,
or you'll wear yourself out alone.
lots.plain: You may be pouring effort into something that looks real but can't be held. Today, check whether your goal is concrete, and skip any argument that won't change anything.

lots.title: Dragon and Tiger Call
poem: A setback turns into your moment,
dragon and tiger calling in harmony.
The clear sky holds an open road,
and your chance will come again.
lots.plain: The last disappointment is not the final word on where you're headed. Today, try the same thing once more, but change one part of how you go about it.
jieqian: It comes right in the end

lots.title: Treasure in a Dream
poem: You find treasure in a dream
and wake to empty hands.
The hill you dug gave back a hoe;
take another road, with a hand to help.
lots.plain: Holding tighter to one plan may only leave you more tired right now. Today, try a different angle on the problem or ask someone to lend a hand, and steady things first.

lots.title: Eat When Hungry
poem: Good parents pass down to children and grandchildren;
food and clothing come in plenty.
The elders at home are content;
eat when hungry, sleep when tired.
lots.plain: Your life right now is asking for nothing dramatic, just ordinary care done well. Today, put family and daily life first: eat a proper meal and get to bed a little early.

lots.title: Stream Over Small Stones
poem: Over small stones the stream runs loud;
under wind and moon, helpers are busy.
Ask which way the road goes,
and don't follow the flowers' scent into the woods.
lots.plain: There are good people and good roads around you, but the way forward isn't obvious yet. Today, get clear on where you're going before you start, and notice what's tempting you off course.

lots.title: Wind Past the Ear
poem: Gossip is wind passing your ear;
what you need will gather on its own.
Don't keep holding the old story;
your heart and theirs are much alike.
lots.plain: Old grievances and chatter are taking up more of your mind than they deserve. Today, let one past slight go, and in a conversation look for the ground you share instead of the point you disagree on.

lots.title: Tend Your Own Field
poem: Remember these plain words:
don't chase a new trade far from home.
Keep to the craft you already know;
other roads won't serve you now.
lots.plain: Your steadiness right now comes from the work you already know, not from something unfamiliar. Today, skip the side quest and go one level deeper on a thing you're already good at.

lots.title: A Tower Ringed by Thorns
poem: You climb the high tower to hide;
thorns grow thick on every side.
The sky is high, the span uncertain;
grab one thing and you may lose two.
lots.plain: This is a moment where pushing forward could cost more than it gains. Today, keep a low profile, take no big risks, and look after your own plans first.

lots.title: Kindling for the Fire
poem: You carry kindling to fight a fire,
and it burns across three thousand miles.
Rather than chase glory now,
put things away and spare your heart.
lots.plain: Some of what you're doing to fix a conflict may be feeding it instead. Today, if tension flares, pause before you answer and give it time to cool.

lots.title: Songs Under the Moon
poem: Poems at sunset, songs beneath the moon,
laughing along with the moment's play.
Some meetings can't be avoided;
voices rise together in one song.
lots.plain: Connection is finding you through easy, social moments rather than careful planning. Today, relax at whatever gathering you're in and be sincere, because someone may surprise you.

lots.title: Danger That Isn't
poem: Dawn and dusk, you're quietly upheld;
what looks like danger isn't danger.
When a trusted guide takes your hand,
good things follow close behind.
lots.plain: The problem in front of you may look worse than it actually is. Today, stay calm and bring it to someone you trust, since it may untangle faster than you expect.

lots.title: A Needle Lost at Sea
poem: Long ago a needle slipped from the boat;
today you search the sea again.
Even if the needle can be found,
it will cost you time and care.
lots.plain: You're trying to recover something lost, and it's possible, but not quick. Today, write out the steps it would take and work through just the first one.

lots.title: Fish in the Net
poem: A fish swims in a blue-green pool,
then the net closes on every side.
You search for a way to turn free;
struggling now only stirs up trouble.
lots.plain: You may feel hemmed in, and thrashing about would only tangle things further. Today, avoid stirring up conflict and simply watch, quietly, for where the opening is.

lots.title: Joy That Isn't Yet
poem: The joy in front of you isn't joy yet;
not in danger, and not at ease.
Why cut flesh to patch a wound?
Keep to the old way and wait.
lots.plain: Something may look good on the surface while quietly costing you more than it gives. Today, don't trade a long-term good for a short-term win; hold your ground and wait for a better time.

lots.title: Frost at Dusk
poem: The road is steep, the horse is tired,
the troops are scattered and worn.
High waves split the oar and boat;
at dusk, flowers fade and frost comes down.
lots.plain: This stretch is rough on several fronts at once, and that's a reason to slow down, not to push. Today, rest and restock, and set out again only when you're properly ready.

lots.title: A Golden Scale
poem: A golden thread weighs your heart:
no more, no less, not light or heavy.
Live upright all your days,
and your gifts will shine on their own.
lots.plain: Your fairness and honesty are the strongest things you have going right now. Today, when you make a call, treat everyone evenly and stick to the facts; people notice.

lots.title: Joy at the Gate
poem: Good news gathers at your door;
a house of kindness grows bright.
Plans and harvests come together,
and what aches finds its remedy.
lots.plain: Good things are growing out of the kindness you and those around you have built up. Today, gather with family or friends, share a piece of good news, and pass the good mood along.

lots.title: Plum on a Winter Ridge
poem: Winter comes; one plum branch on the ridge,
leaves gone, wood bare, yet unbroken.
When spring arrives in a hurry,
it blooms first among all flowers.
lots.plain: If you're in a low season, it is a season, not a verdict. Today, don't give up on the thing you care about; do one small thing to keep it alive until warmer days.
jieqian: An arrow shot at the sky

lots.title: The Restless Bee
poem: Day after day, like a bee for flowers,
you fly southwest, then off to the east.
Spring ends, the blossoms fall and vanish,
yet you keep the same old route.
lots.plain: Running in many directions may be leaving you tired with little to show for it. Today, stop and name the one thing you actually want, and put your energy there.

lots.title: Two Arrows, One Bow
poem: You see a dragon at the crossroads,
a heart pulled between two homes.
One bow strung with two arrows,
and the horse can't settle down.
lots.plain: You may be trying to keep two options alive, and it's keeping you unsettled. Today, compare them honestly side by side, then choose one and give it your full effort.
jieqian: No way out of the layers

lots.title: Honey and the Sting
poem: To get the honey, you go to the hive,
but fear the needle in its tail.
Another path may open before you,
yet in the dark, thorns grow thick.
lots.plain: An opportunity that looks sweet may carry a cost you haven't seen yet. Today, ask a few more questions about it and understand the price before you decide.

lots.title: Spring Thunder Wakes
poem: Spring thunder rolls, and the insects sing;
with one turn you rise from the mud.
Now you see how comings and goings work;
in a single morning, you become a dragon.
lots.plain: The ground under you is waking up, and the change you've been waiting on is ready to move. Today, take one bold, concrete step toward the thing you've wanted to start.
jieqian: All the way to the top

lots.title: A Bird Into the Cage
poem: Like a swan that flies into a cage,
you try to turn, but find no way.
North, south, east, west, each door is hard;
this is a time to wait.
lots.plain: You may have walked into a tight spot, and forcing your way out now would only make it tighter. Today, hold off on bold moves or new promises, and take time to see clearly where you stand.

lots.title: Carrying a Tiger Uphill
poem: Like carrying a tiger over a high mountain,
trembling, your courage gone cold.
Then, without warning, good things turn up;
still, keep yourself safe and steady.
lots.plain: You're under real pressure, and careful, steady steps are what will carry you through it. Today, take things in order and protect your footing; a turn for the better may be just one step ahead.

lots.title: The Carp in Deep Water
poem: Fish and dragons swim in one pond,
so keep still in the deep water.
One morning your head breaks the surface
and you leap the gate of dragons.
lots.plain: You are in an ordinary spot among many others, and your moment hasn't arrived yet. Today, do the unglamorous work in front of you steadily and let your strength quietly build.

lots.title: Fame Beyond the Clouds
poem: In dreams you speak of great riches,
and fame drifts far beyond the clouds.
Long rivers and distant mountains blur the truth;
a wise word makes you smile again.
lots.plain: Big dreams are floating out of reach right now, too far away to act on. Today, turn one plan into a single first step, and listen openly if someone offers advice.
jieqian: Talking of dreams in a dream

lots.title: Water Just Warm
poem: Cold water, not yet brought to boil,
rests neither cold nor hot, just warm.
To walk the world you need nothing else
when a hundred skills live in your hands.
lots.plain: You're at a good, balanced point, and what you carry inside is your real strength. Today, spend some time learning or sharpening one skill so you feel steady wherever you go.

lots.title: The Unpaid Promise
poem: You made a wish to stay safe,
and safe you stayed, but never repaid.
Do not forget what you once vowed;
a promise is not a light thing.
lots.plain: Some promise you made, maybe a small one, is still waiting to be kept. Today, look over what you've told others you'd do and follow through on at least one of them.

lots.title: Sun and Moon Shine Clear
poem: You climbed the high cliffs seeking wisdom
when a call came from an unexpected door.
Sun and moon keep shining in clear skies;
an honest name travels across four seas.
lots.plain: You're walking one path, and an opening may appear from a direction you weren't watching. Today, keep doing things the honest way and stay ready to say yes when a good chance shows up.

lots.title: Fair Wind Home
poem: Parasol leaves fall as autumn closes,
and the traveler drifts homeward like a cloud.
The sky lends a strong and steady wind,
carrying a boat full of treasures home.
lots.plain: A season of effort is winding down, and the wind is at your back. Today, wrap up one thing you've finished, write down what you learned, and let others see the work.

lots.title: A Lotus in the Fire
poem: Fierce flames climb into the sky,
yet a lotus blooms inside the fire.
In the end it comes to no harm,
still growing leaves, roots, and branches.
lots.plain: Things around you may feel heated, but what matters to you is not being destroyed. Today, when pressure rises, slow your breathing and respond one step at a time.

lots.title: Waiting for the Full Moon
poem: Like the moon on its third night,
half there, half missing, not yet whole.
Wait for the fifteenth's gentle evening,
when light and fullness reach everywhere.
lots.plain: What you're working on is only halfway formed, and that's simply where it is in its cycle. Today, take the next ordinary step and let it grow toward complete in its own time.

lots.title: Dreaming Under the Pines
poem: Trading good character for a name,
even good fortune can turn around.
Drunk, you lose track of the road,
dreaming hazily in the pine shade.
lots.plain: Right now it's easy to get swept up in image, noise, or other people's expectations and lose your footing. Today, keep a clear head, skip one optional social obligation, and don't make big decisions in the heat of the moment.
jieqian: A fish out of cold water

lots.title: Fog on the Mountain Road
poem: Dark clouds and fog veil the mountain road;
still the moon returns to full.
Wake from the long dream through your books,
and a guide will lead you higher.
lots.plain: The way ahead isn't clear yet, and pushing blindly won't help. Today, invest in yourself by reading or learning something useful, and notice who around you might point the way.

lots.title: Thunder on Open Ground
poem: Spring flowers blaze across the terrace,
and carts roll in from far away.
Leap the three great waves at the gate,
like thunder breaking on open ground.
lots.plain: Energy is gathering around you, and this is a moment to make your move. Today, give your full effort to the exam, pitch, or presentation that matters most.
jieqian: Like a poor man finding treasure

lots.title: Halfway Up at Sunset
poem: Halfway up the ridge, the sun sinks low;
steep cliffs offer no easy rest.
Look up, the sky still watches over you,
and you are standing on safe ground.
lots.plain: You're in a tiring stretch, with the hardest part of the climb still around you. Today, slow down, focus on your next secure step, and reach out to someone who has your back.

lots.title: The Wooden Tiger
poem: A tiger carved of wood guards the door,
fierce to look at, harmless to touch.
There is truly nothing here to fear;
only worry makes the heart jump.
lots.plain: Something or someone looks more threatening than it actually is. Today, before reacting, take a calm second look and check the facts.

lots.title: Jade Inside the Stone
poem: Your comings and goings move with ease,
like flawless jade hidden in stone.
When a wise friend shows you where to look,
the treasure shines and brings you joy.
lots.plain: There is real value in something you have that hasn't been seen yet, maybe not even by you. Today, ask someone you trust to look over your work and point out what you might be missing.

lots.title: A Letter on the Wind
poem: Suddenly good news takes to the sky,
and a boat comes home full of treasure.
Ask about the road ahead: it is kind,
with helping hands still waiting further on.
lots.plain: Momentum is on your side, and support is closer than you think. Today, move forward on something you've been waiting to start, and reach out to one person who can help.

lots.title: Road Wide as Sky
poem: Smooth out your worried brow and step forward;
the road ahead is turning bright.
A great path opens, wide as the sky,
and open hands make an open heart.
lots.plain: The worries that held you back are loosening, and the way forward is wider than it looks. Today, take one step you've been hesitating on, and share something generously with someone.

lots.title: Student Returns a Master
poem: Since youth you've planned and built with care;
what you need comes without chasing it.
Plan your hopes together with a partner;
you leave a student, return a master.
lots.plain: Your steady planning and effort have been adding up, even when you couldn't see it. Today, sketch out one long-term goal and choose a small action that moves it forward.

lots.title: Rain on Phoenix Feathers
poem: The phoenix's feathers drip with rain,
and for now the sparrows mock it.
One day the clouds will clear,
and it will smooth its wings again.
lots.plain: You may feel underestimated or treated unfairly right now, and it stings. Today, don't let it sink in too deep; take care of yourself first and trust that you'll have room to spread out again.

lots.title: The Zither and the Listener
poem: Don't stoop to petty people's ways;
when things slip, blame flies everywhere.
A zither's song needs an ear that understands;
keep steady and quiet, and calm returns.
lots.plain: There's friction or misunderstanding around you, and arguing it out won't settle much. Today, step back from who's right and wrong, and spend time talking with one friend who really gets you.

lots.title: When the Golden Rooster Crows
poem: Ambition is built one morning at a time;
too much wine and pleasure wears it down.
When the golden rooster calls the dawn,
good things come out to meet you.
lots.plain: Distractions and easy comforts are quietly draining the energy your goals need. Today, cut back on one indulgence and get up early to do the single most important task first.

lots.title: The Shining Pagoda
poem: A towering pagoda, unlike any other,
gleams with light on all eight sides.
Set your heart and practice with devotion;
do good, and blessings find their way.
lots.plain: Kindness and steady intention are your brightest qualities right now. Today, do one small good thing for a coworker or a stranger, and notice how it lifts your own mood too.

lots.title: Flowers in a Mirror
poem: A candle lit in the wind throws thin shadows,
blurring like flowers in a mirror.
You keep tidying it, again and again,
not seeing it's only a drifting raft.
lots.plain: Some of what's keeping you busy looks lively but may not lead anywhere real. Today, drop one task that's just for show and give that energy to a goal that truly matters.

lots.title: A Bird Near the Net
poem: In your plans and travels, go slowly;
rushing and fretting only stir up trouble.
Like a bird that flies into a net,
it takes time to find the way out.
lots.plain: Things feel tangled right now, and hurrying will likely tighten the knot. Today, hold off on launching anything new, keep your emotions steady, and step away from arguments until the picture clears.

lots.title: Rain After the Fire
poem: Reins in hand, you charge straight ahead,
half into worry, half into trouble.
Like a house where fire takes hold,
until the season's rain falls and cools it.
lots.plain: Pushing hard right now may run you into more than you expected. Today, ease off the charge, prepare a backup plan for one important thing, and remember that difficult stretches do pass.

lots.title: Keep the Old Path
poem: The signs have spoken plainly to you;
the restless mind talks itself into fog.
The elder takes the lot and walks home,
keeping old ways until the time comes.
lots.plain: Overthinking and hurrying are clouding your view more than any outside problem. Today, avoid big changes, keep your current rhythm, and let the right moment come to you.
